title: ToolDefinition
description: A tool of a node, as she sees it.

description.description: What it does, for the model.

parameters.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of the arguments, an object.

keepResult.description: Whether her calls of the tool and what it answers stay in her history: her later prompts give them again, so she can go on from what she read (a file, a page). Leave it out (false) for a tool that only does something (since 1.18).
